input: Set up a rain barrel for garden watering

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Rain Barrel for Garden Watering
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to install a rain barrel system to collect and use rainwater for watering their garden.

questions.title: Do you already own a rain barrel or need to buy one?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with sourcing/purchasing a barrel or jumps straight to installation.

questions.title: What is the barrel's intended water source?
questions.description: Clarifies whether water will be collected from a downspout, roof gutter, or another runoff point.

questions.title: What size garden area does the barrel need to support?
questions.description: Helps determine the required barrel capacity and whether one barrel is sufficient.

questions.title: Is this installation on a municipal or private well water property?
questions.description: Identifies whether local regulations or permits may apply to rainwater harvesting in the user's area.

questions.title: Will you water by gravity flow or a pump?
questions.description: Determines the elevation and pressure requirements for the barrel placement and outlet setup.

questions.title: What surface will the barrel sit on near the downspout?
questions.description: Identifies whether a stable platform, cinder blocks, or a dedicated stand needs to be built or sourced.

questions.title: Do you want overflow water redirected somewhere specific?
questions.description: Establishes whether an overflow hose or secondary drainage solution needs to be planned.
